# VARIATION_V2 smoke-var report (generated by variation_v2.py --summarize)

success = share of seeds reaching the target (colouring: 0 conflicts; Max-Cut: cut >= 0.99 x reference; QKP: profit >= 0.99 x optimum). q = mean quality (colouring: -conflicts; Max-Cut: cut/ref; QKP: profit/opt). ovh = runtime energy overhead of the mitigation in % of the machine's own run energy; once = one-time programming + calibration energy (nJ); dA = area overhead in % of the machine's area.
